reproducibility: image-builder replaces the random GPT GUIDs the partitioning crate would stamp into the UEFI image with values derived from the image's own content, so rebuilding the same commit on the same platform produces identical bytes — shown locally by two builds with identical digests for all eight images. The published files are the CI-built bytes; a Windows build differs because Rust embeds the build host's source paths in panic locations. A second, independent CI run of this release is compared in docs/REQUIREMENTS.md (REL081-004).
